Plugin.Name: Audiobookshelf Streams
Plugin.Overview: See who is listening on your Audiobookshelf server right from the Unraid Dashboard. Shows each user as Listening, Paused or Connected, with the book cover, title and author, a progress bar and the device in use. Includes auto-refresh. Requires an admin API token from your Audiobookshelf server; the token stays on the server and is never sent to the browser.
